Sampling as Qwen3.5 (thinking mode, coding). Qwen3.6's chat template can keep earlier thinking (preserve_thinking), which helps multi-turn agent work, so reasoning_content stays on assistant messages. vLLM: --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice; llama.cpp: --jinja, KV cache q8_0 or f16 (not q4_0).

Reference model for the crit plan (plan/01-model-protocol.md). effective_context, tool_output_cap_tokens and shell_timeout_s are crit's plan defaults for this size, not model-card values; the eval may change them.
